subject.title: Intermittent 30+ minute workspace-sandbox prep on cold-start (5.19-beta.1)

question: Should this intermittent OrbStack cold-start report remain separate from the narrower wedged-Docker timeout issue after the timeout PR is resolved?
rationale: The report points to workspace-sandbox prep broadly, while the open candidate fix addresses only part of the Docker control-plane timeout surface and introduces compatibility-sensitive timeout/default behavior.

options.title: Keep separate until proven fixed
options.body: Track this issue as broader workspace-sandbox cold-start reliability work until a merged fix has bounded prep coverage and real cold-start proof.

options.title: Fold into Docker timeout issue
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90980 as canonical only if maintainers decide the Docker no-timeout root cause fully explains this report.

recommendation.title: Keep separate until proven fixed
recommendation.body: Track this issue as broader workspace-sandbox cold-start reliability work until a merged fix has bounded prep coverage and real cold-start proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about sandbox backend lifecycle, prune behavior, and timeout/fail-soft product defaults, and this person has recent adjacent architecture and cleanup history.
